description: P56 (plan M11 §2.5, §2.6): the bead sets a braid wears, for the hair and for the beard apart. A set is one mesh of the giant index (Beads_<key>) with its beads on the anchors of every style that has them (the braided styles); GiantLook shows a set's beads on the shown styles only, so a style without anchors wears none. None is the default. P61: the iron rings of the rival giants' braided beards (npc: their looks only, never offered by the creator; Appearance.is_npc).
